name: ttl-live
description: TikTok LIVE events in Node, with no sign server, no native module and no browser.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.example.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .test-dist/*.test.js
scripts.listen: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.example.json && node .example-dist/listen.js
scripts.proto:check: npm run proto:generate && git diff --exit-code -- src/gen/webcast
scripts.schema:check: npm run schema:generate && git diff --exit-code -- src/gen/json
scripts.generate: npm run proto:generate && npm run schema:generate
scripts.check: npm run proto:check && npm run schema:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
